description: Fetch the robots.txt of the given public http(s) URL's site (at most 500 KiB, 5 s timeout, redirects followed) and report whether PriceMovedBot is allowed to fetch that URL under RFC 9309 rules: verdict allowed, disallowed, or skipped (robots.txt unreachable, 5xx/429, or too complex: PriceMoved would not fetch). Does not fetch the page itself. Domain names only (no IP addresses or ports). About 10 checks per minute and 30 per hour per network; results cached 10 minutes. Same engine as GET /api/robots-check.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

name: robots_check
title: Check whether a site's robots.txt allows PriceMovedBot
